status_semantics: The radar is an evidence-evaluation framework. UNKNOWN and NOT_INGESTED are never converted to PASS. A site is only Module-1-qualified when all five domains have a passing gate; the current public repository does not yet contain numeric TIR/SAR telemetry or transformer procurement-event evidence, so those domains remain unverified until such evidence is ingested.

criterion_1_2_flop_bounding_box.baseline_chip: NVIDIA H100 SXM FP16/BF16 Tensor Core
criterion_1_2_flop_bounding_box.invariant: At exactly 100 MW all three scenarios fall between 1.0705e26 and 1.1256e26 FLOPs; the scenario labels describe their facility assumptions, not the numerical ordering of their FLOP outputs.

criterion_1_3_thermodynamic_heat_signatu.status: computed from electrical capacity; site-specific cooling telemetry is not inferred

A_wholesale_market_queues.limitation: The repository is a public-queue/connection registry, not a complete load census for every utility. ERCOT GIS and SPP GI are not themselves equivalent to complete load-project registers; CAISO is Cluster-15-only in the current snapshot; MISO's generator queue is not synonymous with new-load requests.

criteria.tir: Landsat-8/9 TIRS and Sentinel-3 SLSTR, 8-14 micrometre LWIR, anomaly threshold >=0.5 K over ambient baseline
criteria.sar: Sentinel-1 C-band and commercial X-band SAR such as Capella for multi-temporal construction activity
criteria.optical: Commercial optical imagery <=0.5 m/pixel for physical cooling/chiller verification

B_satellite_remote_sensing.safe_semantics: Epoch AI site evidence is retained as independent facility evidence, but it is not converted into numeric TIR/SAR anomaly measurements.

D_epoch_ai.semantics: Epoch values remain separate from queue-origin capacity. Queue IDs are recorded only when the site identity is defensible.

domain_3_entity_resolution.anti_defamation_rule: No public dashboard record is labeled as a shell company, front, diversion front, illegal cluster, or similar unsupported characterization.

domain_4_geospatial_interface.coordinate_policy: Use embedded county/zone lookup where available; otherwise state/province centroid fallback. Missing coordinates are skipped without throwing.
domain_4_geospatial_interface.rto_filter_behavior: Table RTO filtering updates map markers and fits the viewport to the filtered region.

ferc_rd26_7_000.status_semantics: FERC order directing NERC to file reliability standards concerning computational load integration; it is not itself a telemetry rule for private software.

nerc_project_2026_02.citation: Project 2026-02 Computational Loads; August 2026 formal posting includes CLO-001-1, CLO-002-1 and CLO-003-1 drafts
nerc_project_2026_02.status_semantics: Draft standards under development, not a final effective standard as of this record.

ceii_18_cfr_388_113.status_semantics: Existing CEII designation/access framework; the radar does not assume a particular dataset qualifies as CEII.
